name: PlanogramAuditor
tagline: Planogram Auditor turns a store visit into a quick, visual shelf check.
description: Planogram Auditor turns a store visit into a quick, visual shelf check. The planned layout (the planogram) is drawn as bays, shelves and product slots, and each slot is as wide as the number of facings the product should have. You tap a product and record what you found: Compliant, Out of stock, Wrong position, Price / label issue or Damaged / low facings, plus the facings you actually saw and a note.
features: A visual shelf map of bays
Shelves and product slots sized by facings
Tap or keyboard to record Compliant
